assistant|hendricks_gin_profile: Hendrick's gin has notes of rose, cucumber, and juniper
assistant|recipe_pimms_cup_twist: 1 1/2 oz Hendrick's gin, 1/2 oz lemon juice, 1/2 oz simple syrup, 1/2 oz Pimm's No. 1, splash of ginger beer; garnish with cucumber, mint, fruit
assistant|recipe_cucumber_gimlet: 2 oz Hendrick's gin, 1 oz fresh lime juice, 1/2 oz simple syrup, 1/2 oz cucumber juice; garnish with cucumber slice
assistant|recipe_rose_petal_spritz: 2 oz Hendrick's gin, 2 oz Prosecco, 1 oz rose syrup or rose liqueur, 1 oz lemon-lime soda; garnish with rose petal
assistant|recipe_gin_gin_mule: 2 oz Hendrick's gin, 4 oz ginger beer, squeeze of lime juice; garnish with lime wheel and mint sprig
assistant|recipe_summer_solstice: 2 oz Hendrick's gin, 1 oz peach puree, 1 oz lemon juice, 1/2 oz honey syrup; garnish with rosemary and peach slice
assistant|recipe_hendricks_high_tea: 2 oz Hendrick's gin, 1 oz lemon juice, 1/2 oz honey syrup, 1 oz tea (earl grey or English breakfast); garnish with lemon slice
assistant|cucumber_juice_vs_muddling: Cucumber juice gives a milder, sweeter, clear flavor; muddling slices gives more intense fresh flavor, texture, and visual appeal
assistant|simple_syrup_recipe: Classic simple syrup: 1 cup sugar dissolved in 1 cup water over heat, cooled and strained; keeps in fridge up to 2 weeks
assistant|simple_syrup_amount_pimms_cup: Pimm's Cup with a Twist needs about 1/2 oz (15ml) simple syrup, adjustable to taste
assistant|simple_syrup_variations: Simple syrup can be infused with cucumber, mint, lemon, citrus peels, herbs, spices, or flowers
assistant|citrus_syrup_options: Recommended citrus syrups: grapefruit, lemon-ginger, and orange-blossom to complement Hendrick's gin and cucumber
assistant|citrus_syrup_recipe: Citrus syrup: 1 cup sugar, 1 cup water, 1/2 cup fresh citrus juice plus optional peel, ginger, or orange blossom water; steep 30 min
assistant|grapefruit_varieties: Ruby Red is sweet-tart with red flesh; White is tart and more bitter; Pink is sweet and tangy
assistant|grapefruit_syrup_recipe: Grapefruit syrup: 1 cup sugar, 1 cup water, 1/2 oz... 1/2 cup grapefruit juice plus optional peel slices; steep 30 min, strain, refrigerate
assistant|garnish_ideas: Garnish ideas: cucumber slice/wheel, grapefruit slice, mint sprig, edible flowers (violas, pansies, lavender), fresh fruit
assistant|presentation_elements: Presentation elements: large clear ice cubes or spheres, garnish picks, fresh herbs, fruit slices, and a garnish tray for guests
assistant|collins_glass_endorsement: Collins glass endorsed as perfect for the Pimm's Cup with a Twist; tall slender shape showcases color layers and garnishes
assistant|syrup_flavor_suggestions: Suggested trying lemon-ginger or orange-blossom simple syrups if feeling adventurous
